texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！从我们目前对其语言的破译来看，这些外星人称他们自己为“伊拉斯协约国”。他们是一个在一百万年前掌控着星系的这片区域的星际政权。

这些外星人似乎是六肢的哺乳动物，有多处文献交叉印证了一种叫“贾沃疹”的流行病席卷了他们的帝国，带来了灾难性的后果甚至直接导致了他们的毁灭。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! From what we have translated so far of their language, we have learned that these aliens called themselves the "Irassian Concordat." They were an interstellar power that held sway over this region of the galaxy a little over a million years ago.

They appear to have been six-limbed mammalians, and there are several references to some sort of plague called the "Javorian Pox" which swept across their empire with devastating results, possibly leading to their extinction.

texts.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自伊拉斯协约国的史前古器物。他们是一个大约一百万年以前统治一大片星系的星际政权。六肢哺乳动物伊拉斯人的免疫系统异常地脆弱，使其面对异星传染病时十分容易夭折。据称，伊拉斯人似乎是灭绝于一种称为贾沃疹的席卷全境的瘟疫。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母星系的位置。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Irassian Concordat. They were an interstellar power that held sway over a portion of the galaxy a little over a million years ago. The six-limbed mammalian Irassians had unusually weak immune systems that made them especially vulnerable to alien diseases. Some sources claim the Irassians were rendered extinct by the Javorian Pox, a devastating plague that swept across their empire.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

texts.zh: 我们的科学官将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求伊拉斯人的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Irassians to our own.

texts.zh: 尽管生物学领域的积累并未救伊拉斯人于水火，但是他们，毫无疑问，是这一方面的专家。我们的科学家已从他们的发现中吸取了富有价值的经验。
texts.en: Though it clearly did not save them, the Irassians were admittedly experts in the field of biology. Our scientists have adapted what was worthwhile from their findings.

texts.zh: 我们已成功将伊拉斯人的文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对生命科学的见解将极大地帮助我们。
texts.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Irassian artifacts into our research process. Their insights into biological research will greatly aid our own.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是一个大型的伊拉斯殖民地，这个殖民地有工业发展和环境改造的迹象。如同其他的伊拉斯殖民星球上一样，留下的化石讲述了一个悲伤的故事——由于贾沃疹的肆虐，人口急剧减少，这场灾难肆虐了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的所有定居点。在星球轨道上还存有大量碎片残骸，应该是一场战役留下的。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was once a large Irassian colony, showing signs of both industrial development and terraforming. As on other Irassian worlds, the fossilized remains tell a harrowing tale - the population rapidly succumbed to the Javorian Pox, and there appears to have been widespread panic in all of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s major settlements. There is also an unusually large amount of debris in orbit, possibly the remnants of a battle.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上伊拉斯人的殖民地因贾沃疹而毁灭，但有证据表明这事情发生前[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾受到封锁。我们需要更深入地检查轨道碎片，以获取更多信息。
texts.en: The Irassian colony on [From.GetName] fell to the Javorian Pox, but there is evidence that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was subjected to a blockade just before this happened. To learn more, we will have to examine the orbital debris more closely.

texts.zh: 我们分析了轨道中漂流的碎片，同时考古学家推断[From.From.GetName]上的伊拉斯殖民地在受毁灭前曾经受到过军事封锁。伊拉斯人的舰队当时试图隔离[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]以遏制贾沃疹。当时至少有一打民用飞船试图突破封锁，战况十分惨烈，但很明显一部分飞船成功脱逃了。
texts.en: We have analyzed the orbital debris, and our archaeologists conclude that [From.From.GetName] was subjected to a military blockade before and during the Irassian colony's demise. The Irassian fleet had strict orders to quarantine the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] in a vain attempt to contain the Javorian Pox. At least a dozen civilian ships made an attempt to break the blockade, and despite the heavy fighting it appears some were successful.

title.zh: 伊拉斯母星系位置确定

texts.zh: 在详细地研究了我们发现的伊拉斯人文物之后，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学家设法推测出了伊拉斯的星系坐标——古老的伊拉斯人文明的母星系！我们应该在别人之前尽快向这个恒星系派出一支探险队。
texts.en: After intense study of our recovered Irassian artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Irass - the home system of the ancient Irassian civilization! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

texts.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的伊拉斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
texts.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Irassian home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

texts.zh: 伊拉斯星系是古老的伊拉斯协约国的核心。
texts.en: The Irass system was the heart of the ancient Irassian Concordat.

texts.zh:
伊拉西亚，伊拉斯协约国的前母星。有人在最近（2000年以内）系统地轨道轰炸了[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的每一寸地表；这些人很有可能是被误导，认为贾沃疹可能会重现人世。

尽管如此，地表仍然有数十亿个伊拉斯人的化石。他们在帝国最后阶段死于贾沃疹，当瘟疫传播到母星时，大部分伊拉斯协约国的星球已经陷落了，他们的附庸也都公开反抗。

从轨道卫星里复原的数据来看，大部分伊拉斯人的态度已经是听天由命。瘟疫初期的恐慌已经不存在了，大部分人已经接受了帝国即将覆灭的事实。
texts.en:
Irassia - the former homeworld of the Irassian Concordat. Someone has relatively recently (within the last 2,000 years) gone through the trouble of systematically bombarding every square meter of the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface from orbit - possibly a misguided attempt to keep the Javorian Pox from resurfacing.

Despite this, the surface is still covered in the fossilized remains of the billions of Irassians who succumbed to the plague in the final years of their empire. By the time it had spread to their homeworld, most of the worlds in the Irassian Concordat had already fallen, and their alien vassals were in open revolt.

Judging by ancient satellite logs recovered from orbit, the mood among the population on the Irassian homeworld was largely resigned by this point. The widespread panic that accompanied the first outbreaks of the pox on the colonies was largely absent, as most had come to accept the fact that the end was drawing near.

tooltips.zh: 解锁稀有文物行动：伊拉斯人的秘密
tooltips.en: Minor Artifact Action Unlocked: Secrets of the Irassians

texts.zh: 这是伊拉西亚，或者说曾经辉煌的伊拉斯协约国首都的残骸。就算有任何物品在伊拉斯人母星毁灭的过程中遗留下来，肯定也被其他人拿走了。有迹象表明最近就有人访问过这里。
texts.en: This is Irassia, or at least what remains of the once proud capital of the Irassian Concordat. If any artifacts survived the destruction of the Irassian homeworld, someone else has already made off with them - there are clear signs that someone visited here recently.

texts.zh: 这颗星球过去有复杂的生物圈，直到被一次大型轨道轰炸抹平了。调查表明这颗[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]是一个名叫“伊拉斯协约国”的古老文明的首都。我们并没有太多的发现，因为其他探索者已经把大部分有价值的东西都拿走了。
texts.en: This world once supported a lush biosphere, until it was erased by a massive orbital bombardment. The survey indicates that the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] was the capital of an ancient civilization known as the "Irassian Concordat." We have learned little else, since other explorers have already made off with everything of value.

title.zh: 伊拉斯母星系位置确定

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出伊拉斯人母星系的秘密坐标！
texts.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Irassian home system!

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh:
可以明显看出[From.GetName]，这个古代伊拉斯的殖民地，受到了严重的轨道轰炸。在太空中可以清楚地看到一些大型弹坑，这些弹坑所在地便是在大约120万年前[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的主要人口居住中心。

从轰炸中幸存的那些可怜人，很快又死于横行于大部分伊拉斯殖民地的贾沃疹。
texts.en:
It is immediately apparent that [From.GetName], an ancient Irassian colony, has been the victim of extensive orbital bombardment. Large craters are still visible from space where the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s major population centers used to be roughly 1.2 million years ago.

The handful of survivors from the initial bombardment appear to have succumbed shortly afterwards to the Javorian Pox that was then ravaging most Irassian worlds.

texts.zh: 一百二十万年前，[From.GetName]遭受到一次猛烈的轨道轰炸，在此之前[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾是伊拉斯人的一个繁荣的殖民地。也许一次考古调查可以了解更多情况。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was subjected to massive orbital bombardment 1.2 million years ago, but before that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was a flourishing Irassian colony. Perhaps an archaeological expedition can learn more.

texts.zh: 我们的考古团队从[From.From.GetName]的一处监听哨站废墟回收到了一段通讯记录。它记录了一支在轨的伊拉斯舰队指挥官与位于伊拉西亚的舰队总部之间的一段通讯内容。指挥官不满总部要求“净化”殖民星的所有生物以防止瘟疫散播。虽然争吵未果通讯记录就中断了，但很明显指挥官最终还是执行了该命令。
texts.en: Our archaeological expedition has recovered a communications log from the ruins of a listening post on [From.From.GetName]. It shows the contents of a transmission between the commander of an Irassian fleet in orbit, and their naval headquarters on Irassia. The commander questions orders to "purge" the colony of all life to prevent the spreading of the pox. Although the log ends before the issue is resolved, the orders were evidently carried out.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh:
这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]是丘格拉的母星，他们是伊拉斯协约国征服的一个物种。这种软体类物种正要突破星际旅行的瓶颈，而伊拉斯人发现了他们。经过漫长的冲突，丘格拉的多个城市被摧毁，最终丘格拉还是被征服了。

地表有证据表明其后几十年里，有大量伊拉斯军团驻扎在这里。这说明丘格拉对于伊拉斯人的统治表示不满。
texts.en:
This [From.GetPlanetMoon] was the homeworld of the Joggra, a subjugated client species of the Irassian Concordat. A molluscoid species that was on the verge of achieving space flight when the Irassians discovered them, the Joggra were conquered after a lengthy military campaign that devastated many of their cities.

There is evidence on the surface that a sizeable Irassian military garrison was stationed there for decades afterwards, suggesting that the Joggra were not content to remain under the Irassian yoke.

texts.zh: 软体类物种丘格拉起源于[From.GetName]，它是一个被伊拉斯协约国所征服的物种。我们对其知之甚少，不过没准一次考古调查便可以弥补这点。
texts.en: The molluscoid Joggra originated on [From.GetName], a subjugated client species of the Irassian Concordat. Little is known of them, but perhaps an archaeological expedition can remedy this.

texts.zh:
在[From.From.GetName]上发现了一段丘格拉的亚空间信息碎片，此信息是发向伊拉斯协约国的各个附庸国的母星的：

“反抗残酷统治者的时候到了。我们的特工得知贾沃疹只影响瘦弱的伊拉斯人，但是所有的物种都能作为瘟疫的载体。我们必须尽全力渗透他们的世界，空间站，飞船，还有他们的*滋啦滋啦*！

终于，伊拉斯人遇到了他们那庞大舰队无法击败的敌人。*滋啦滋啦*万岁，这个千载难逢的机会不容错失！”
texts.en:
Remnants of a Joggran subspace message have been found on [From.From.GetName], which appears to have been transmitted to the homeworlds of the Irassian Concordat's other client species:

"The time to strike at the tyrants is now. Our agents have learned that the Javorian Pox only affects the weak Irassians, but any species can act as a carrier for the disease. Every effort must be made to infiltrate their worlds, their space stations, their ships, even their *unintelligible*!

At long last, the Irassians have met a foe that cannot be brought low by their vaunted starfleet. By the *unintelligible*, this opportunity must not be squandered!"

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]是提德戈120万年前的母星，他们是伊拉斯协约国征服的一个物种。他们是有翼的节肢动物，出土的化石证明他们至少可以短距离飞行，而他们留存下来的少量建筑可以支持这个理论。

不幸的是，这个文明的遗物所剩无几，因为[From.GetPlanetMoon]似乎受到严重的轨道轰炸。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] was the homeworld of the Ti'Derg roughly 1.2 million years ago, a client species of the Irassian Concordat. They were winged arthropoids, and recovered fossils suggest they were capable of at least limited flight - what little we have seen of their surviving architecture supports this theory.

Unfortunately, there are few remains of this civilization, as the [From.GetPlanetMoon] seems to have been subjected to a massive orbital bombardment.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是提德格的远古母星，但一百二十万年前，它遭受了一次全面的轨道轰炸。我们知道提德格是伊拉斯人的几个附庸物种之一，但究竟是什么原因促成了这次轰炸依旧是个谜。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was the ancient homeworld of the Ti'Derg, but it suffered a comprehensive orbital bombardment 1.2 million years ago. It is known that the Ti'Derg were one of several Irassian client species, but exactly what prompted this bombardment remains a mystery.

texts.zh:
我们对于[From.From.GetName]上外星废墟的研究让我们更加了解伊拉斯协约国的最后时期。伊拉斯人怀疑是提德戈和其他一些附庸国联手故意将贾沃疹散播到所有伊拉斯人的星球。

我们永远都不知道这是否是真的，但是伊拉斯人认为证据确凿，因此派出舰队从轨道上将[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]彻底毁灭。
texts.en:
Our study of the alien ruins on [From.From.GetName] has offered us new insights into the final moments of the Irassian Concordat. The Irassians believed that the Ti'Derg were part of a plot together with several of the Concordat's other client species to deliberately spread the Javorian Pox to Irassian worlds.

Whether this was true or not we will likely never know, but the Irassian fleet felt the evidence was compelling enough to incinerate the entire [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] from orbit.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh:
有迹象表明[From.GetName]直到120万年前还是一个生机勃勃的伊拉斯殖民地。鉴于年代久远，在[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表的废墟状况良好，没有轨道轰炸或者冲突的痕迹。

伊拉斯殖民者都死于贾沃疹，之后当地的植物群占据了废弃的城市，在城市上方覆盖了厚厚的一层植被。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] shows every sign of having been a thriving Irassian colony world up until approximately 1,200,000 years ago. Given their age, the ruins found so far on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface are in fairly good condition. There are no signs of orbital bombardment or armed conflict.

The Irassian colonists appear to have succumbed to the Javorian Pox, after which the aggressive native flora reclaimed the lifeless cities and hid them under a dense layer of vegetation.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]上伊拉斯人的殖民地遗迹里只剩下化石与废墟。它看起来像是成为了贾沃疹的另一个受害者，但也许一次考古调查可以让我们对这个殖民地的命运有更多的了解。
texts.en: Only ruins and fossils remain of the Irassian colony on [From.GetName]. It appears to have been another victim of the Javorian Pox, but perhaps an archaeological mission can shed some more light on the colony's fate.

texts.zh:
在清除干净[From.From.GetName]上某处伊拉斯古老定居点丛生的杂草，并且设置了能量力场发生器来防止捕食者进入后，我们的考古学家对废墟进行了彻底的挖掘。现在我们更加了解伊拉斯人的日常生活了。

考古学家们的最大发现是一个数码星图册，它是用来教导伊拉斯人儿童关于自己的帝国的。其中也包含了关于协约国所有附庸物种的详细而带有污蔑性的描述。
texts.en:
After clearing away the vegetation from one of the ancient Irassian settlements on [From.From.GetName] and setting up energy field generators to keep predators at bay, our archaeologists conducted a thorough excavation of the ruins. We now have a much better understanding of what daily life in Irassian society was like.

Among the most valuable finds is a digital atlas, apparently used to teach Irassian children about their empire. It also contains detailed and disparaging descriptions of all of the Concordat's subjugated client species.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]地表的地洞是120万年前伊拉斯人在这颗星球上采掘作业留下的痕迹。[Root.GetName]进行了彻底的地表扫描，但没有发现任何遗留下来的采矿设施。
texts.en: A series of deep boreholes on the surface of [From.GetName] are all that remain of the Irassian mining operation that was active on this world some 1.2 million years ago. The [Root.GetName] has conducted a thorough surface scan, but we have yet to find the remains of any actual mining facilities.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上深深的矿洞表明，这里曾经是伊拉斯人的采矿基地。我们的考古学家想要深入调查。
texts.en: The deep boreholes on [From.GetName] indicate the former presence of an Irassian mining base. Our archaeologists would like to investigate them further.

texts.zh: 在调查了[From.From.GetName]上的深井之后，我们的考古学家在其中一个的底部发现了一百多名伊拉斯人矿工的化石。他们似乎同样是击垮伊拉斯协约国的贾沃疹的牺牲品。矿工的同伴们徒劳地为求防止瘟疫扩散，在撤离[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]之前将遗体扔到了深井底部。
texts.en: After investigating the boreholes on [From.From.GetName], our archaeologists found the fossilized remains of over a hundred Irassian miners at the bottom of one of them. They appear to be more victims of the Javorian Pox that brought about the fall of the Irassian Concordat. In a futile attempt to keep the disease from spreading, their comrades dumped the bodies down one of the boreholes before the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] was evacuated.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是一个刚刚发展起来的伊拉斯殖民地，它刚好是在伊拉斯人的大灭绝开始的时候建立起来的。我们在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的北半球发现了一个殖民地和初级宇航中心的遗迹。从化石看来，这颗星球是毁灭了伊拉斯人的贾沃疹的首批受害者。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was a young Irassian colony that had only just been founded at the time of their extinction. We have found the sparse ruins of a single settlement and a rudimentary spaceport in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere. Judging by the fossilized remains, this world appears to have been among the first to be hit by the Javorian Pox that ravaged Irassian space.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]曾是一个很早就受到贾沃疹打击的受害地，我们的考古学家想研究伊拉斯人的殖民地以发现蛛丝马迹，从而追踪瘟疫的病原。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was an early victim of the Javorian Pox, and our archaeologists would like to study the former Irassian colony for clues as to the origin of the disease.

texts.zh:
我们的考古学家在[From.From.GetName]上有惊人的发现。所有的证据都表明贾沃疹就是从这个不起眼的[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上起源的！

由于检疫封闭系统的制造缺陷，一种稀有的当地细菌入侵了伊拉斯人的殖民地，之后又传播到了一艘停靠的贸易船的空气滤网上。因为瘟疫传播的速度十分惊人，不知道伊拉斯人有没有机会了解瘟疫的起源。
texts.en:
Our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have made a startling discovery. All evidence points conclusively towards this unassuming [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] having been the origin of the Javorian Pox!

A rare form of native bacteria invaded the Irassian colony due to a manufacturing flaw in a quarantine seal, and from there it spread to the air filters of a visiting merchant ship. Since the pox spread at such an unprecedented rate, it is doubtful whether the Irassians themselves ever had time to learn of its origin.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 一艘伊拉斯巡洋舰在一百多万年前被遗弃在[From.GetName]的近距轨道上。这艘缓慢旋转的飞船没有战斗损伤的痕迹，所有的逃生舱也在船上。正如所料，舰体内部也没有能源信号。
texts.en: A derelict Irassian cruiser has been left forgotten for over a million years in close orbit around [From.GetName]. The slowly spinning vessel shows no obvious signs of weapon damage, and all escape pods remain accounted for. As would be expected, no power signatures can be detected from within its hull.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一艘废弃的伊拉斯巡洋舰。一队考古学家已经整装待发。
texts.en: We have encountered a derelict Irassian cruiser orbiting [From.GetName]. A team of archaeologists stand ready to board the vessel.

texts.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]上方轨道漂浮着的伊拉斯巡洋舰里面有死去的全体船员。他们大多都死于后来灭绝整个伊拉斯一族的贾沃疹，但也有些船员是由于想用逃生舱逃走而被船上的星际卫兵射杀。从复原的日志文件来看，在瘟疫出现之后舰长严令隔离整艘船。
texts.en: The inside of the Irassian cruiser found orbiting [From.From.GetName] contains the dead remains of its full crew complement. Most of them perished as a result of the Javorian Pox that would later render the Irassians extinct, but some of the crew were gunned down by marine guards while trying to reach the escape pods. According to recovered log files, the captain issued strict orders to quarantine the ship after the outbreak became apparent.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上方发现了许多轨道装置的碎片，从碎片中复原的一些物件证明，这个空间站是一百二十万年前的伊拉斯协约国的疾病控制中心。

伊拉斯人比其他任何已知物种都更容易受到外星疾病的影响，他们的公共健康预算要和军事预算一样多。尽管如此，留存下来的记录还是表明他们整个物种都死于贾沃疹。
texts.en:
Debris from what must have been a massive orbital installation has been discovered above [From.GetName]. Artifacts recovered amongst the debris have confirmed that this space station served as the headquarters of the Irassian Concordat's Authority of Disease Control some 1.2 million years ago.

The Irassians were far more susceptible to alien diseases than most known species, and the budget of their public health institute nearly rivaled that of their military. Despite this, surviving records show that their entire species perished from the Javorian Pox.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上发现了伊拉斯人的轨道空间站碎片，这里应该是他们疾病控制权威部门的总部，若想获得更多信息，需要对废墟进行广泛搜寻。
texts.en: The shattered remains of an Irassian orbital station was found above [From.GetName]. It appears to have served as the headquarters of their Disease Control authority, but to learn more we will need to conduct an extensive search of the debris field.

texts.zh:
我们从[From.From.GetName]上方的星际碎片群中复原了一些研究日志。它们最后的一些记录都是关于寻找肆虐伊拉斯人的贾沃疹的解药，但因为形势不断恶化，他们也变得更加绝望了。

最后一条记录显示瘟疫已经在整个空间站里失控蔓延了，一条附录记录了所有制造解药的失败尝试。这些人希望他们的研究数据能够为以后的伊拉斯科学家提供帮助。
texts.en:
We have recovered the remnants of several research logs from the debris field above [From.From.GetName]. Their final entries are all focused on finding a cure for the Javorian Pox that was sweeping across the Irassian Concordat, and they grow increasingly desperate as the situation worsened.

The last entry reveals that the pox had spread in an uncontrolled fashion on the space station itself. An attachment details all of their failed attempts to produce a cure in the vain hope that the data would be useful to future generations of Irassian scientists.

texts.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

texts.zh: 一个小型伊拉斯军用监听哨站建在挖空的小行星内部。这个监听阵列装配有朝向邻近星系的强力传感器阵列。这些装置都无法使用了，这颗小行星似乎已经被其他人调查和掠夺过，而且这样的事情有可能还不止一次发生。
texts.en: A small Irassian military listening post has been built into a hollowed-out portion of this asteroid's interior. It is equipped with an array of powerful sensors that seem to be aimed towards neighboring systems. None of them are functional, and the asteroid appears to have been gone over and looted at least once by another party.

texts.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]上发现了被遗弃的军用监听哨站。我们认为这是古老的伊拉斯协约国设立的。
texts.en: An abandoned military listening post has been found on asteroid [From.GetName]. We believe it may have been constructed by the ancient Irassian Concordat.

texts.zh: 我们发现在伊拉斯人的扩张时期，他们利用[From.From.GetName]小行星上的监听哨站来监测附近其他文明，制定进攻计划。这些计划非常成功，伊拉斯人很快就成为这个星域的主宰势力。当他们被贾沃疹消灭时，这个监听哨站早已被伊拉斯的军队放弃了。
texts.en: We have learned that the Irassians used the listening post on asteroid [From.From.GetName] to spy and plan attacks on neighboring civilizations during the expansionist phase of their empire. These attacks met with dramatic success, and the Irassians soon became the dominant power in this section of the galaxy. By the time they were decimated by the Javorian Pox, this listening post had long since been abandoned by the Irassian military.

texts.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

sections.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]上方发现了一些轨道残骸，它们曾属于一个巨大的伊拉斯科研空间站。伊拉斯人在研究什么项目目前还不清楚，但他们的设备似乎指向气态巨行星本身。
texts.en: Orbital wreckage that once belonged to a sizable Irassian research station have been found above [From.GetName]. Exactly what the Irassians were researching here remains unclear, but their instruments appear to have been aimed towards the gas giant itself.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]周围轨道上发现了一座古老的伊拉斯人的研究站遗址。看上去伊拉斯出于某种原因一直在研究这个气态巨行星。
texts.en: Orbital debris from an ancient Irassian research station has been found above [From.GetName]. The Irassians appear to have been studying the gas giant for some reason.

texts.zh:
对于[From.From.GetName]上方轨道残骸的研究有了一些答案，让我们了解到了他们的科学家在研究什么项目。复原的日志提到了在巨型气体行星内部漂着某种人造物体。

尽管进行了多次大气层扫描，[Root.GetName]也没有发现日志里提到的物体。所以有可能之后伊拉斯人把它提取出来了，或者别人在伊拉斯人被消灭之后这么做了。
texts.en:
An analysis of the Irassian orbital wreckage discovered above [From.From.GetName] has yielded few answers, but we have some idea of what their scientists were studying in their research station. Recovered logs make references to some kind of artificial object floating deep inside the gas giant's crushing atmosphere.

The [Root.GetName] has found no trace of such an object despite repeated atmospheric scans, so either the Irassians finally managed to retrieve it or someone else did in the countless years since their demise.

texts.zh: 无论这个世界的生物圈里面生活着什么，现在一切都已经逝去了。
texts.en: Whatever biosphere this world may have once supported is long gone.

sections.zh: 无论这个世界的生物圈里面生活着什么，现在一切都已经逝去了。
sections.en: Whatever biosphere this world may have once supported is long gone.
